Read IMAGE-GNM's surface runoff fraction and slope layers.

Source: R/image_gnm_runoff.R
read_image_gnm_runoff.Rd

Reads the two 0.5-degree layers IMAGE-GNM's surface runoff nitrogen needs, as its authors published them with Beusen et al. (2015) (doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015-supplement):

  • surface_runoff_fraction: f_qsro, the share of total runoff that runs off the surface, the product f_qsro(slope) f_qsro(texture) of eqs. 3-4 (p. 4049), the median over the 90 m cells of each 0.5-degree cell. Their model reads it from water_input/pcrglobwb_100/fQsro.map rather than computing eq. 4, and it is read here the same way; the land-use factor of eq. 3 is applied by calculate_n_leaching().

  • slope_m_per_km: the median slope (m/km) of each cell, from fix_input/slope.map, which their erosion term reads.

Only cells where fQsro.map holds a value (its land mask) are returned. A balance row on a cell outside it gets no value from a join and calculate_n_leaching() aborts there rather than run nothing off.

The supplement is resolved from dir, else the WHEP_IMAGE_GNM_DIR environment variable, else a local cache populated on first use: the 59.7 MB archive is downloaded from its DOI, verified against its SHA-256 and the two layers unpacked. The archive's publisher prints no checksum, so the SHA-256 is the one WHEP recorded on 2026-10-12; inst/scripts/download/download_image_gnm.R fetches the same archive into a directory for WHEP_IMAGE_GNM_DIR.

Usage

read_image_gnm_runoff(dir = NULL, verify = TRUE, example = FALSE)

Source

Beusen, A. H. W., Van Beek, L. P. H., Bouwman, A. F., Mogollon, J. M. and Middelburg, J. J. (2015). Coupling global models for hydrology and nutrient loading to simulate nitrogen and phosphorus retention in surface water - description of IMAGE-GNM and analysis of performance. Geosci. Model Dev. 8, 4045-4067. doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015 ; supplement doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015-supplement .

Arguments

dir

Optional directory holding the unpacked supplement (the folder that contains GMD_beusen_supplement/), overriding WHEP_IMAGE_GNM_DIR. Defaults to NULL.

verify

If TRUE (default), each layer is checked against its recorded size and SHA-256 before it is read.

example

If TRUE, return a small fixture instead of reading data. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble with lon, lat (0.5-degree cell centres), surface_runoff_fraction (0-1), slope_m_per_km and source_image_gnm, the supplement's DOI.

Examples

read_image_gnm_runoff(example = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 5
#>      lon   lat surface_runoff_fraction slope_m_per_km source_image_gnm          
#>    <dbl> <dbl>                   <dbl>          <dbl> <chr>                     
#> 1   5.25 52.2                   0.0136           1.21 doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 2  10.2  46.2                   0.525          221.   doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 3 -93.2  41.8                   0.0532           6.02 doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 4  -3.75 40.2                   0.112           11.1  doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 5  31.2  30.2                   0.0339           3.15 doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 6 100.   30.2                   0.522          115.   doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 7  78.2  22.2                   0.289           26.1  doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
#> 8 -60.2  -3.25                  0.0486           3.66 doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-20…
